sections.title: Describe obligations and work activities
sections.content: Combine *tener que*, *hay que* and familiar present-tense verbs to describe a simple working day.

sections.title: Workday patterns
rows: Tengo que trabajar a las ocho.
I have to work at eight.
It is necessary to arrive early.
Tenemos que ir a la oficina.
We have to go to the office.

items.spanish: Tengo que trabajar a las ocho y escribir informes.
items.english: I have to work at eight and write reports.
Afterwards, I work in the office.

sections.content: A workday can combine a personal obligation, a general rule and ordinary present-tense activities: *Tengo que trabajar*. *Hay que llegar temprano*. *Escribo informes*.
